research_role: translate the binary same-industry Q1 confirmation mechanism once using outcome-blind natural event concurrency

frozen_strategy.signal: unchanged weekly completed-close Industry Diffusion plus Low-MAX Champion signal
frozen_strategy.selection: take the exact diffusion-Q1 first two names only when both share the same signal-date PIT industry
frozen_strategy.pair_order: higher diffusion_score, then lower exact max_return20, then symbol
frozen_strategy.entry: next legal open; a blocked name is not backfilled
frozen_strategy.holding: 20 market sessions to due open, plus unchanged QD-010 pre-effective and legal-fill handling
frozen_strategy.cohort_capital: minimum of available cash and one-half of pre-entry NAV
frozen_strategy.capital_rationale: the outcome-blind 99-event schedule has median two concurrent h20 event cohorts on active days; one-half is the single natural fully-invested divisor
frozen_strategy.weights: equal across executable names in the event cohort
frozen_strategy.cross_event_cash_transfer: cash may fund later valid events, but no position is sold early and no borrowing occurs

required_diagnostics: annualized and total return, max drawdown, Sharpe and Calmar
turnover, trade count, severe loss, breadth, concentration and capacity
event funding fraction and cash-constrained event count
comparison with frozen Champion and diffusion-Q1 Top-2
prohibited: one-third, one-quarter, full-NAV, volatility-targeted, or optimized cohort capital
two-industry event, Top-1, Top-3, score-gap, threshold, or market-state rescue
changed signal, Low-MAX, horizon, entry, exit, cost, or weighting
OOS, confirmation, validation, or live claim
